title: Supply, Installation and Commissioning of Water Treatment Equipment at the Municipal Water Works

clauses.text: This tender invites sealed bids for the supply, installation and commissioning of water treatment equipment at the municipal water works.
The bidder must have an annual turnover of at least ₹50 crore.
The bidder must have at least 5 years of experience in executing similar works.
Bids must be submitted within 21 days from the date of publication of this notice.
To encourage participation by smaller firms, only bidders whose annual turnover does not exceed ₹10 crore are eligible to bid.
An Earnest Money Deposit of 2% of the estimated contract value must accompany the bid.
The successful bidder shall complete the work within 12 months of the award of contract.
